user.title: Connect to the hikbridge add-on
user.description: Point this at the Hikvision PTZ Bridge add-on. With host networking enabled the add-on listens on 127.0.0.1:8654.

camera.title: Choose a camera
camera.description: The add-on is driving more than one camera. Pick the one this entry should control. Add the integration again for the others.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the add-on. Is it started?
error.invalid_auth: The add-on rejected the auth token.

move.name: Move
move.description: Nudge the camera pan/tilt in a direction.

speak.name: Speak
speak.description: Play audio on the camera speaker.
